newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko, Morgan Stanley to manage JR East listing.
newsitem.headline: Nikko, Morgan Stanley to manage JR East listing.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd and Morgan Stanley & Co International Ltd will jointly lead manage the secondary listing of East Japan Railway Co (JR East), JNR Settlement Corp said on Wednesday.
JNR Settlement Corp, a government entity in charge of selling state-owned shares of Japan Railway (JR) group firms, did not specify a target date for the listing.
The body said in a statement that it would first like to implement the planned listing of Central Japan Railway Co (JR Tokai) before listing more JR East shares.

JR Tokai, one of six railway operators formed by the 1987 break-up and privatisation of the government's debt-ridden Japanese National Railways (JNR), will be the third JR firm to be listed on Japan's stock exchanges. A total of 1.5 million JR Tokai shares will be listed on October 8.
Japan listed 2.5 million state-owned shares of JR East in 1993, followed by the flotation of 1.7 million shares in West Japan Railway Co (JR West) in October last year.
